kv.statistic: Exact occupancy-change events; P99 and mean weighted by GPU-time.

fluid.constraints: max-min rate per transmission, bounded by link and both endpoint NICs; Decode strict priority in preemptive model
fluid.chunk_semantics: Prompt segments are contiguous bytes of the same flow; no per-chunk propagation or overhead. Fluid sharing/preemption already permits other flows to progress.
fluid.route_cost: Original queued work proxy plus all current unfinished network bytes/link capacity; no future arrivals or output lengths.
